tone_mechanisms_observed: hyper-specific domestic detail held in flat register; reflection reuses the same plain diction as narration, never shifting into essayistic vocabulary
very long additive sentences joined by 'and' in which reflection unfolds as continuation of event rather than commentary — reflection proceeds without halting plot
deliberate monotony as a device: even cadence sustains reflective saturation without rhetorical peaks
sparse figuration — detail itself carries the reflection; anti-symbolic
mechanics.point_of_view: First person, close in time to the events but told with retrospective composure: near and cool at once.
mechanics.tense_and_structure: Past-tense narration dominant; reflection occurs inside the past-tense scene (thinking now, about then) rather than in a timeless essayistic present.
mechanics.rhythm_and_cadence: Even, paratactic cadence with no rhetorical peaks; the flatness is the effect and the risk.
mechanics.psychic_distance: Self-distance via retrospection: the narrating self is separated from the experiencing self by the composure of the telling.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Plain additive parataxis; metaphor rare; evaluating asides folded into narration. The work proves high reflective dosage is possible at novel scale and documents its cost — the navel-gazing objection (see dossier §G-1) made explicit by critics.
mechanics.copyright_note: In copyright. Described by technique only; no passage reproduced.
